claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC theorem proves the complete on-shell linearized Einstein--Maxwell solution tangent maps into the complete on-shell linearized pure-Weyl--Maxwell solution tangent at the certified parallel-flux product background. It uses the convention-adjusted Einstein--Maxwell Bach/Chevreton factorization and includes curvature and flux lower-order terms on shell. It does not construct the off-shell curved BV chain map, quotient injection, cyclic or presymplectic map, nonlinear closure, second-order physical obstruction, causal dynamics, observables, scattering, or quantum equivalence.

direct_radion_fixture.maxwell_perturbation: delta F=0 with fixed magnetic flux

required_checks: choose exact graviton and photon representatives on the product
evaluate the quadratic Chevreton trace on their first-order Maxwell jets
separate a genuine second-order obstruction from a removable Weyl/diffeomorphism term
construct formal adjoints, magnetic-bundle patching, and the covariant presymplectic comparison
next_gate.target: compute the second-order Chevreton defect on representatives of the injected graviton-plus-photon cohomology and construct the off-shell curved BV row maps and cyclic pairing

on_shell_factorization.C_Ch_definition: convention-adjusted trace of the Chevreton electromagnetic superenergy tensor
on_shell_factorization.background_property: nabla Fbar=0 because the aligned factor volume forms are parallel
on_shell_factorization.domain: four-dimensional source-free Einstein--Maxwell equations with cosmological constant Lambda
on_shell_factorization.linearized_consequence: delta C_Ch=0 for arbitrary (h,a) because the derivative of a quadratic form vanishes at nabla Fbar=0
on_shell_factorization.structural_property: C_Ch is homogeneous quadratic in nabla F

primary_literature_identity.source_equation: Eq. (66), translated to the repository curvature, stress, and coupling conventions
primary_literature_identity.title: The Chevreton Tensor and Einstein-Maxwell Spacetimes Conformal to Einstein Spaces

quadratic_onset.interpretation: the Chevreton defect cannot obstruct the linear tangent inclusion but can first enter at second order

theorem.solution_tangent_map: injective before quotient; quotient injectivity remains a separate gauge/global question
theorem.statement: Every solution of the complete linearized source-free Einstein--Maxwell equations at the certified parallel-flux product background solves the complete linearized pure-Weyl--Maxwell equations with the same (h,a).

tuning_deduction.linearized_maxwell_identity: the source-free Maxwell equation is identical in both theories
